finalText:
All 5 tests pass now.

The bug was in `computeTotal` in `src/services/pricing.js:9-23`: flat coupons are stored in USD (`coupon.js`), but the old code subtracted `coupon.amount` from the total *after* it had already been converted to the target currency — treating a USD amount as if it were in EUR (or whatever). Fixed by subtracting the flat coupon from the USD subtotal *before* conversion, so the discount gets converted along with the rest of the order.
